# Third-Party Skills

Skills written by other people that I use every day, copied here so you can grab them in one place. **None of these are my work.** Each one keeps its original license; the upstream repository is the source of truth — star it, file issues there, and pull from it if you want the latest version.

中文说明：这里是我日常在用的**别人写的** skill，原样拷贝过来方便一次拿全。版权归原作者，每个都保留原许可证；想要最新版请直接去上游仓库。

| Folder | Author / upstream | License |
|---|---|---|
| [`anthropic/`](anthropic/) | Anthropic — [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE.txt` inside each skill) |
| [`mattpocock/`](mattpocock/) | Matt Pocock — [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) | MIT ([LICENSE](mattpocock/LICENSE)) |
| [`axtonliu/`](axtonliu/) | Axton Liu — [axtonliu/axton-obsidian-visual-skills](https://github.com/axtonliu/axton-obsidian-visual-skills) | MIT ([LICENSE](axtonliu/LICENSE)) |
| [`orca/`](orca/) | Stably AI — [stablyai/orca](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) | MIT ([LICENSE](orca/LICENSE)) |
| [`openspec/`](openspec/) | OpenSpec contributors — [Fission-AI/OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec) | MIT ([LICENSE](openspec/LICENSE)) |

Not included, on purpose: Anthropic's `docx` / `pdf` / `pptx` / `xlsx` (proprietary license — no redistribution) and `doc-coauthoring` (no license file upstream). Get those from [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) directly, or enable them in Claude's settings.
